title: All-to-all, 4x4x4 torus (64 chips)
intro:
All-to-all sends a different piece of data from every chip to every other chip, and nothing is added up. Mixture-of-experts models use it to send each token to the chip holding its expert, and back. Every piece travels its own path, so the cost is set by how many hops paths take and how evenly they spread over the links. Each dot is one piece; click a chip to follow only its traffic.

On a torus a piece moves one dimension at a time, so the hop count grows with the slice: 3 on average here, about 8 on an 8x8x16 slice.
segments: Every chip sends to all 63 others at once over dimension-order routes (X, then Y, then Z). Paths average 3.0 hops, at most 6. The links between neighbours each carry many pieces.
